checks.question: Do the source-linked production surfaces and distinct section models produce the independently reconstructed forces?

detail.tolerance: forces 0.01% + 1e-4 SI; pose 1e-7; actual vertex positions 0.2 mm

checks.question: Do the actual moving wing masses exchange spring/kinetic energy consistently, including known damping?

detail.tolerance: 0.5% initial elastic energy + 0.1 J; nontrivial motion; damped case loses >1 J

checks.question: Do coupled wing/body accelerations and a short neutral-input response match the independent mass-matrix model?

detail.tolerance: initial acceleration 0.01% + 1e-4; 40 ms pitch 0.5 mrad, rate 0.005 rad/s

checks.question: Does the aircraft complete the published takeoff/bank scenario using the finite engine and fuel allowance?

detail.tolerance: Engine cap exact to .001 W; energy derivative 10 W + 0.3%; fuel 0.1 g + 1%; source forces within .1 N; >=2 s clear by .3 m before runway end, bank >.25 rad and >1 m clear at 70 s.

checks.question: Does the configured motor-off glide descend with force-derived aerodynamic energy loss?

detail.tolerance: 10 s actual glides at 90%,100%,110% trim speed; positive descent, no arbitrary L/D band; energy residual <1 J + 0.5% losses; independently reconstructed acceleration within .02 m/s².

checks.question: Do all three actual tyre axles stay aligned with the lateral airframe axis during straight rolling and flight?

limitations: Provisional mechanical-v6-source-first smoke test; one task and selected properties, not scientific validation.
The supplied world and UI earn no model points. Aircraft state hooks do not prove all mesh coupling.
0 binary visual checks remain ungraded; automated totals are not full-task scores.
Browser isolation is defense in depth, not a hardened hostile-code sandbox.
score_scope: Six binary task outcomes only; file-only protocol and human aesthetic realism are separate.

file_only_validity.scope: Observed tool requests only. Blocked out-of-policy requests fail. File rereads, patch feedback and mental review are allowed; private reasoning is not inspected.

numeric.reference_equations: Independent mass points, centroid, inertia, local sections and coupled E-L solve; no candidate counters/helpers used as expectations.
